where.if: AND (equipment_code LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR equipment_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM eq_equipment ORDER BY equipment_id DESC
SELECT FROM eq_equipment ORDER BY equipment_id DESC LIMIT 1001

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eq_equipment (equipment_code, equipment_name, equipment_type, model, location, equipment_status, version, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{equipmentCode}, #{equipmentName}, #{equipmentType}, #{model}, #{location}, #{equipmentStatus}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
